english.title: Glyphic Parchment
english.detail:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <Name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

english.title: Glyphic Parchment
english.objective: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
english.progress: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
english.complete:
Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
english.detail:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

english.title: The Harvester
english.detail: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
english.progress: You seemed troubled, <name>. How go your lessons in the Barrens? Did you find something that disturbs you?
english.complete:
I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...

But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

english.title: The Harvester
english.objective: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
english.progress: You seemed troubled, <name>.  How go your lessons in the Barrens?  Did you find something that disturbs you?
english.complete:
I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled.  But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens.  I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...

english.title: Dig Rat Stew
english.objective: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
english.detail:
A <Class> like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
english.progress: Whack enough dig rats yet, <name>?
english.complete:
Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.

Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go.

Here you go!

english.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
english.objective: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
english.detail:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!

english.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
english.objective: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
english.complete:
So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.

However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.

In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

english.title: Field to Clear
english.objective: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
english.detail:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?

english.title: Field to Clear
english.objective: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
english.progress: There might be a chance to get down without them noticing me soon...
english.complete:
Thank you for helping me out, <name>. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!

This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.

I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.

english.title: The Runed Scroll
english.objective: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.
english.detail:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
english.progress: Whaddya got?
english.complete: Well now... Where did you find this?

english.title: Horde Presence
english.objective: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.
english.detail:
This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

<Name>, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, <Name>. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.
english.progress: We cannot allow the Alliance on our land, <name>. Make this known.
english.complete:
You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, <name>. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less Alliance runners in the Barrens. They will think again before sending another this way.

Thank you.

english.title: Pigments for Paints
english.objective: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
english.detail:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

english.title: Pigments for Paints
english.objective: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
english.progress:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
english.complete:
Ah, thank you, <name>.

It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.

Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.

english.title: Never Coming Back
english.objective: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
english.detail:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

english.title: Never Coming Back
english.objective: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
english.progress: Once I get out of this place, I'm never returning.
english.complete:
Ha! That's right, you beasts!

Thanks. That does seem to already have helped.

english.title: A Void Path
english.objective: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
english.detail:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.

english.title: A Void Path
english.objective: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
english.complete:
<You hear the voice of Va'xug echoing from within the floating eye.>

"Was it that simple? No matter. This vision will assist me in wrangling my unruly Voidwalker along the correct trail when I resummon him. Thank you, traveler. Cut through this forest with sure steps."

<The Eye of Kilrogg begins to dissipate.>

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.objective: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.detail:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
english.progress: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
english.complete: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.objective: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
english.detail:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
english.progress: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
english.complete: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.

english.title: The Sacred Flame
english.objective: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
english.detail:
Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
english.progress: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
english.complete:
I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.

My thanks, <name>. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.

english.title: Melor Sends Word
english.objective: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.detail:
<Name>, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
english.complete:
So, <name>, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young <class>, then listen on...

english.title: Steelsnap
english.objective: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.detail:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, <Name>.  Find him, and defeat him.
english.progress: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, <name>?
english.complete:
In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

And that, <name>, is your lesson this day.

english.title: Baron Marinous
english.detail:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.

english.title: Baron Marinous
english.objective: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.progress: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, <race>... what have you brought me?
english.complete:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending in Mathystra? Could it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.

english.title: Culling the Threat
english.objective: Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
english.detail:
Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.

Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.

I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.
english.progress: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
english.complete:
Well done, <name>.

We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.

english.title: Fallen Sky Lake
english.objective: Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
english.detail:
Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak.  I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost.  I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them.  Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
english.progress: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, <name>? If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
english.complete:
Oh, <name>, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!

I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.

english.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
english.objective: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
english.detail: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
english.progress: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.
english.complete: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.

english.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
english.objective: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
english.progress: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.
english.complete: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.
english.detail: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.

english.title: The Tower of Althalaxx
english.detail: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
english.complete:
I knew you would be up to the task, <name>.

I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, <name>, as well as this gift.
